question_en: How much work is needed to stretch a spring with $k=100\ \mathrm{N/m}$ from its natural length by $0.20\ \mathrm{m}$?

question_en: A force $F(t)=6t^2$ (newtons, seconds) acts on a body for $0\le t\le2\ \mathrm{s}$. The impulse delivered is
question_uz: Jismga $0\le t\le2\ \mathrm{s}$ davomida $F(t)=6t^2$ (nyuton, sekund) kuch ta'sir qiladi. Kuch impulsi qancha?
question_ru: На тело в течение $0\le t\le2\ \mathrm{с}$ действует сила $F(t)=6t^2$ (ньютоны, секунды). Чему равен импульс силы?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. J = ∫₀² 6t² dt = 2t³ |₀² = 16 N·s.
Asos: J = ∫F dt = Δp.

uz: Impuls — kuchdan vaqt bo'yicha integral: $$J=\int_0^2 6t^2\,dt=2t^3\Big|_0^2=16\ \mathrm{N\cdot s}$$
ru: Импульс — интеграл силы по времени: $$J=\int_0^2 6t^2\,dt=2t^3\Big|_0^2=16\ \mathrm{N\cdot s}$$
en: Impulse is the time integral of force: $$J=\int_0^2 6t^2\,dt=2t^3\Big|_0^2=16\ \mathrm{N\cdot s}$$

distractors_en.D: $F(2)\cdot\Delta t$ — the force was taken as constant
distractors_en.E: the exponent was raised by $2$ without dividing: $6t^4$
